contract.name: Rust compatibility, initial Linux track
limitations: This is a finite executable evidence index, not a proof that the Rust specification is exhausted.
A passing legal-unsupported test verifies honest rejection, not language support.
Cross-target and earlier-edition cells remain open independently of this initial track.
Suite failures are retained as failures, never automatically reclassified as expected unsupported.
Existing suites have mixed oracle coverage. Only tests invoking the exact verifier establish pinned stock agreement.

gates.purpose: Evidence system rejects malformed, partial, stale and tampered evidence.
Mandatory compiler graph structural integrity and ratchets.
Unchanged source programs and real native project workflows.
Borrowed closure results, original call evidence and projected reference safety, including known failing coverage.
Bounded reproducible cross-feature stock/native differential generation.
All compiler and engine unit/forged-fact/resource tests, not a language coverage percentage.
Every current integration suite and unit test, with no fail-fast or test filter.

requirements.area: Syntax, names, editions, attributes and privacy
requirements.remaining: Complete stable lexical/grammar/edition and name-resolution rule inventory, including cross-feature cases.

requirements.area: Types, patterns, control flow and inference
requirements.remaining: General type/coercion/inference, all pattern and control-flow interactions beyond delivered slices.

requirements.area: Borrowing, lifetimes, moves and memory validity
requirements.remaining: General regions, reference-bearing closures and aggregates, alias/unsafe soundness, invalid unused bodies.

requirements.area: Traits, generics, associated items, dynamic dispatch and async
requirements.remaining: Complete trait solver/coherence/GAT/HRTB/opaque/async and callable lifetime interactions.

requirements.area: Macros, proc macros and compile-time evaluation
requirements.remaining: General expansion/hygiene/proc-macro execution, const legality and CTFE.

requirements.area: Layout, ABI, linking, panic/unwind and platform
requirements.remaining: Complete Rust/C ABI/layout/unsafe/runtime rules, target features and additional target cells.
Build and test complete pinned upstream libraries unchanged, not just the native source prelude.

requirements.area: Existing Cargo projects and dependency ecosystem
requirements.remaining: General manifests/cfg/features, dependency resolution, build scripts, proc macros, native dependencies and tests.

requirements.area: Demand graph, persistence, isolation and resource failures
requirements.remaining: Remove remaining graph debt and expand invalidation, reuse identity, isolation and fault-injection evidence.

requirements.area: Semantic traceability, fuzzing, minimization and diagnostics
requirements.remaining: Complete independent semantic inventory and upstream conformance imports with licensing, sustained generators/minimizers, diagnostics and soundness campaigns.
Validate every admitted optimization against observable behavior, unsafe/overflow/unwind and cross-feature interactions.
Independent completeness review plus representative performance measurements. Correctness gates do not establish a speed claim.
